# Dev-episode analysis: ep40 and ep26 (2026-10-23, v2)

Run `standin_d6e79acb_a2_mesh_fp`; scored with the official Track 3 metric code (`pathb/gt.py`), public ground truth.

> **Stand-in inputs:** p1b_masks, p1c_camera, p1d_hands come from run `4c2eac31`'s v2 bundles (the team's HF reconstructions at stereo scale), not from v3's own GPU stages; every number downstream of them is a stand-in number. The dev cache (`vm/dev_cache.sh`) replaces them.

**At a glance — biggest flaw:** The object's position in the camera frame (S3b's track seen through P1c's camera) costs 0.51 AUC on its own (mean of the dev episodes).

## f. Biggest flaws

**Biggest flaw:** The object's position in the camera frame (S3b's track seen through P1c's camera) costs 0.51 AUC on its own (mean of the dev episodes).

Evidence: AUC 1.000 → 0.687 (ep40) / 0.292 (ep26); the track's depth sits 5.5 cm / 3.5 cm (median) from the stereo depth; S0.2's true positions alone would score 0.974 / 0.655; the scan at the same poses gains 0.000 / -0.001 AUC.

**Second:** On ep26 the best moving candidate only ties standing still (0.500 AUC).

Evidence: best ref_keyframe 0.500 vs still 0.500; S5's frame-0 seating gap 0.1 cm.

**Third:** On ep26 the second object sits 28 cm (RPE) from where it belongs relative to the first.

Evidence: best ref_keyframe: RPE 28.1 cm, MPPE 14.7 cm; phase 2's anchoring: p2_best RPE 28.3 cm.

## g. Phase A2: S3 variants (A2.5)

| Episode | Variant | Best candidate | AUC | MPPE cm | CD-O cm per object |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ep40 | `phase_a` | `ref_keyframe` | 0.540 | 5.06 | mini_dust_pan 0.24 |
| ep40 | `a2_mesh_fp` | `ref_keyframe` | 0.726 | 3.32 | mini_dust_pan 0.53 |
| ep26 | `phase_a` | `ref_keyframe` | 0.349 | 9.49 | plastic_dish_rack 1.01, white_pot 1.08 |
| ep26 | `a2_mesh_fp` | `ref_keyframe` | 0.500 | 14.66 | plastic_dish_rack 2.77, white_pot 2.07 |

**Decision (spec A2.5 rank rule):** `a2_mesh_fp` — mean rank a2_mesh_fp 1.50, phase_a 1.50. GPU-stage inputs of the source run are stand-ins: the decision is provisional until the dev cache.

Why the AUC rises while CD-O worsens: the kit registers the submitted mesh to the scan scale-free and follows the scan's anchor through our poses. The canonical mesh is fused where the object was seen and registered to the track's rest pose, so that anchor sits on the real object; the team mesh sits off the track, so its anchor swings with every rotation (same poses: raw 0.460 → 0.687 on ep40).
